speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see a newborn presenting with a generalized rash; to determine the cause, how many days old is the baby and was the mother exposed to any illnesses during pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. The history of maternal gonorrhea and the 4-day-old age of the infant strongly support this diagnosis. Please request a Gram stain and culture of the skin lesions to confirm.
